description: This file defines various Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) used in the backend API of an outage management and dispatch platform. It includes record types for entities such as Location, Customer, Crew, Outage, Job, and related request and update models involved in creating, updating, and managing outage workflows.

classes.name: CreateOutageRequest
classes.description: DTO for creating a new outage, including location details and severity.

classes.name: UpdateOutageStatusRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of an outage with optional message and resolution time.

classes.name: AddOutageNoteRequest
classes.description: DTO for adding a note to an outage, with optional creator info.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: DTO to create a new job associated with an outage, including priority.

classes.name: AssignJobRequest
classes.description: DTO for assigning a job to a crew or user, with optional message and changer info.

classes.name: UpdateJobStatusRequest
classes.description: DTO for updating the status of a job with optional message.

classes.name: PagedResult
classes.description: Generic DTO for paginated lists of items.
